title: Opera browser profile
whyItMatters: Opera keeps one browsing identity on macOS. Its history and saved logins show where the user went and what they signed into.
notes: Opera uses a single-profile layout on macOS, with no Default subfolder. Opera GX and Beta use sibling folders and are not covered here.

cleanup.exportFirst: In Opera export bookmarks from the bookmark manager, and save any passwords you keep in the browser.
cleanup.signOut: In Opera sign out of the Opera account in its own account settings, so the account stops trusting this Mac.
steps: Close every Opera window so the profile files are not in use.
Move Opera to the Trash from Applications and empty the Trash.
Delete the com.operasoftware.Opera folder named in the plan if it is still there.
cleanup.risk: Removes the Opera profile on this Mac: history, cookies, saved logins and speed dials.
